# Mind Lab Pro

> > Mind Lab Pro is a universal nootropic supplement featuring 11 clinically-dosed ingredients optimized across 6 brain bio-pathways for cognitive enhancement, memory, and mental performance.

Mind Lab Pro offers a comprehensive nootropic formula backed by clinical research and third-party testing. The site provides detailed ingredient transparency, scientific evidence, and global regional support across multiple markets.
